Happy to kick off the renewal conversation. As Novasoft ramps Q3 model usage, we recommend adding 8x A100 GPUs to your Dedicated reserved pool (separate from shared capacity) to support the 2x peak throughput you mentioned. This expansion includes:

1) When you say "tenant separation: logical isolation + network policies", can you confirm whether our workloads will share the same hypervisor/host as other customers? We have compliance constraints that prefer host-level isolation for any PII workloads.
2) Is the throughput SLO expressed per model or per reserved pool? We need guarantees at the pool level.

Also, procurement will expect a clear rollback/fallback mechanism if utilization drops below the committed levels mid-term. Can you include that in the SOW?

Best,

Monica / team — technical proposal below (summary; attaching design pdf). See reserved_pool_isolation_design.pdf for diagrams and KMS flow.

- Isolation model: We offer two options:
  1) Logical isolation (default): dedicated tenant routing, namespace separation, strict network ACLs, and full KV-prefetch separation. VMs and GPUs are logically scheduled but may share host hardware with other customers.
  2) Host-level isolation (premium): provision dedicated hosts for the pool so Novasoft workloads run on isolated physical hosts. This incurs a higher fixed infrastructure premium and longer lead time for provisioning (~3-4 weeks).

- Encryption & keys: Customer-managed KMS is supported; keys never leave your control. All model payloads are encrypted at rest and in transit.

- Throughput & SLOs: Guarantees are provided at the reserved pool level. Proposed SLA: 99.5% of 1-minute rolling windows meeting >= 140 tokens/sec average across the pool, with documented burst headroom to 220 tokens/sec. Incident credits scale with minutes below threshold.

- Rollback / utilization adjustment: We propose a 90-day utilization review starting at the addendum effective date. If average committed utilization < 60% over the review window, either party can request an adjustment: options include reducing committed GPUs (pro-rated) or converting to a standard burstable pool (different pricing). The SOW will codify the notice period and pro-ration math.

- Operational runbook: automated throttles, alerting to both parties, and a canary routing policy during the first 7 days post-provisioning to prevent noisy-neighbor impacts.

Attachments: reserved_pool_isolation_design.pdf (application/pdf)

Happy to walk through this with Novasoft next week.

— Priyom
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
